limitations.note: The default waveform matches the intended fix, but the agent also rewrote the already-correct odd-mode pulse-width rule and resized both counters, changing behavior for some parameter overrides.

The test could catch the original default-width bug, but its wider configuration expected the agent's new half-period rule rather than checking that the existing parameterized pulse-width behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: Two unrelated command failures caused retries: the failed Git check blocked simulator discovery, and the rejected cleanup command forced the agent to resubmit the entire test invocation.
